subject: reasoning
question:
A dice has its faces marked by letters I, S, H, N, A and T. Two positions of the same dice are given below. Which face is opposite to face I?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aa544a22a6e2ee546e2828835efafd64a1e554e46fe17ec3ac97acff6df4bc58.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

From the given two different cubes the adjacent sides are as shown below :

As N is common on both the dice, it is clear that A, T, S, and H are adjacent to it, and the remaining i.e. I will be opposite to it.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/01420178b9b5df8b9e744239c9e795388f94551e738303eaded25b6fcc602269.png] 

Opposite pairs:

A → H

T → S

I → N

So, the opposite side of "I" will be side "N".

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
